title: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks saw his first game action since his second torn ACL in 2024

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks saw his first game action since his second torn ACL in 2024
sources.description: In Saturday's preseason game, Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks took his biggest step yet in his long road to recovery from his second serious knee injury.
